scope: Decision-oriented primary-source audit; not an exhaustive systematic review or patent/legal opinion.

sources.authors: Dang, Peng and He, Yintao and Li, Huawei
sources.title: VARA: A Voltage-Aware ReRAM-Based Accelerator for Energy-Efficient Computing
sources.access_note: Preprint v1; section 3.3 and Algorithm 1 inspected. Later revision could not be retrieved.
sources.implication: Co-zero grouping comparator; generic activation reordering is occupied.

sources.authors: Chen, Weichong and others
sources.title: DIB-CIM: An Energy-Accuracy Balanced Analog Compute-in-Memory MRAM Using Dynamic-Input-Block Size Arithmetic With Dynamic-Resolution ADC
sources.access_note: Publisher abstract only; DOI 10.1109/TCSI.2026.3726936. Full implementation remains a gap.
sources.implication: Adaptive blocks and conversion precision are mandatory close comparisons.

sources.authors: Park, Jaebeom and Hwang, Seung Eon and Park, Jongsun
sources.title: HINT: A Hybrid SRAM-MRAM Compute-In-Memory with INput-aware Skipping SAR-ADC for Energy Efficient Ternary LLMs
sources.access_note: Primary institutional record; DATE 2026, DOI 10.23919/DATE69613.2026.11539338.
sources.implication: MRAM-related input-aware conversion already exists.

sources.title: A 492.8-TOPS/W STT-MRAM Sparsity-Adaptive Compute-in-Memory Macro for Edge AI Inference
sources.access_note: Publisher record; DOI 10.1109/JSSC.2026.3698324. No faithful circuit reproduction claimed.
sources.implication: Activation-aware sensing comparator family; do not rank headline efficiency.

sources.authors: Song, Choongseok and Kim, Jeeson and Jeong, Doo Seok
sources.title: Optimal Weight-Splitting in Resistive Random Access Memory-Based Computing-in-Memory Macros
sources.access_note: Indexed primary method passages; DOI 10.1002/aisy.202200289, online 2022.
sources.implication: Row parallelism, weight splitting and digital partial sums are existing optimization dimensions.

sources.authors: Arapidis, Emmanouil and others
sources.title: Analysis and Mitigation of IR Drop in Memristor-based AI Hardware Accelerators
sources.access_note: Institutional abstract and indexed author-PDF excerpts; direct PDF failed. DATE DOI 10.23919/DATE69613.2026.11539412.
sources.implication: Balanced mapping plus ADC calibration is a strong simpler alternative.

sources.authors: Chowdhury and Zand and Salehi
sources.title: Dyn-A-Map: Dynamic AI-Model Mapping for robust and accurate MRAM-based analog edge computing
sources.access_note: Primary indexed mapping section inspected; npj Unconventional Computing 3, 27.
sources.implication: Fault-aware mapping is covered; do not equate it automatically with every nominal analog effect.

sources.authors: Zhang, Bonan and Deaville, Peter and Verma, Naveen
sources.title: Statistical Computing Framework and Demonstration for In-memory Computing Systems
sources.access_note: Author PDF noise-model sections inspected. DAC DOI 10.1145/3489517.3530557. Follow-up Section 3.2 check: channel shuffling randomizes deterministic column errors when composing large MVMs; required comparator for F3.
sources.implication: Circuit-calibrated MRAM models and training are stronger comparators than iid Gaussian noise.

sources.authors: Sakr, Charbel and Kim, Yongjune and Shanbhag, Naresh
sources.title: Analytical Guarantees on Numerical Precision of Deep Neural Networks
sources.access_note: Primary PMLR record and selected precision-analysis passages.
sources.implication: Precision bounds constrain broad novelty, not every correlated-MRAM estimator.

sources.authors: Ahmadilivani, Mohammad Hasan and Raik, Jaan and Daneshtalab, Masoud and Jenihhin, Maksim
sources.title: DeepVigor+: Scalable and Accurate Semi-Analytical Fault Resilience Analysis for Deep Neural Networks
sources.access_note: Section III fault model/propagation inspected. Single-bit faults in 32-bit floating point.
sources.implication: Fault-model compatibility is essential before comparing estimator performance.

sources.authors: Boetius, David and Leue, Stefan and Sutter, Tobias
sources.title: Solving Probabilistic Verification Problems of Neural Networks using Branch and Bound
sources.access_note: Primary ICML/PMLR record and prior method passages. Correct full title retained here.
sources.implication: Probability bounds and region integration are existing methods.

sources.authors: Gonugondla, Sujan Kumar and Shanbhag, Naresh R.
sources.title: IMPQ: Reduced Complexity Neural Networks via Granular Precision Assignment
sources.access_note: ICASSP institutional record; DOI 10.1109/ICASSP43922.2022.9746297.
sources.implication: Mixed-precision allocation requires a narrower policy contribution.

sources.authors: Andrulis, Tanner and Emer, Joel S. and Sze, Vivienne
sources.title: RAELLA: Reforming the Arithmetic for Efficient, Low-Resolution, and Low-Loss Analog PIM: No Retraining Required!
sources.access_note: Author PDF arithmetic/slicing and speculation-recovery sections inspected; DOI 10.1145/3579371.3589062.
sources.implication: Signed cancellation and refine-on-demand need a distinct method/implementation.

sources.authors: Nezhadi, Ali and Chatzopoulos, Odysseas and Gizopoulos, Dimitris and Tahoori, Mehdi
sources.title: Trust, but Verify: Reliable Compute-in-Memory via Double-Reference Sensing and Selective Recompute
sources.access_note: Primary KIT abstract; DOI 10.1109/IOLTS69666.2026.11633847; full detector not inspected.
sources.implication: Selective recomputation is prior art; compare the actual detector and fallback costs.

sources.authors: Gonugondla, Sujan K. and Sakr, Charbel and Dbouk, Hassan and Shanbhag, Naresh R.
sources.title: Fundamental Limits on the Precision of In-memory Architectures
sources.access_note: Primary author PDF; ICCAD DOI 10.1145/3400302.3416344.
sources.implication: Intrinsic analog precision limits are established; no universal MRAM variability threshold follows.

sources.authors: Andrulis, Tanner and Chen, Ruicong and Lee, Hae-Seung and Emer, Joel S. and Sze, Vivienne
sources.title: Modeling Analog-Digital-Converter Energy and Area for Compute-In-Memory Accelerator Design
sources.access_note: Model and lower-envelope limitations inspected; architecture-level estimate, not our ADC measurement.
sources.implication: Use for matched-cost sensitivity, then anchor to a chosen circuit.

sources.authors: Li, Humiao and others
sources.title: A lossless and fully parallel spintronic compute-in-memory macro for artificial intelligence chips
sources.access_note: Primary publisher record; DOI 10.1038/s41928-025-01479-y; full text blocked.
sources.implication: A digital-MRAM alternative must be considered at matched precision and throughput.

sources.authors: Hizzani, Mohammad and Yang, Ming-Jay and Heittmann, Arne and Hutchinson, George Higgins and Strukov, Dmitri and Strachan, John Paul
sources.title: Impact of memory device precision in analog combinatorial optimization solvers
sources.access_note: Primary record/excerpts; direct full text/PDF blocked. Revision-15 follow-up checked primary indexed introduction/method-summary passages and institutional metadata; direct full-text redirect remains blocked. No full-read or fresh-versus-frozen equivalence verdict.
sources.implication: Generic coupling-error versus solver-quality studies are not a new Ising contribution.

sources.authors: Wang, Qiuyuan and others
sources.title: Hardware Acceleration of Stochastic Neural Networks Enabled by Bit-Cell Level Co-Design of Magnetic Tunnel Junctions
sources.access_note: Primary method passages previously accessible in this conversation; current retry blocked. DOI 10.1002/advs.78111.
sources.implication: Adaptive sampling/precision is a close comparison; stable and stochastic MTJ roles differ.

sources.title: CN122738551A: Memory computing integrated chip
sources.access_note: Description paragraphs 0038-0044 inspected. Original official document and bibliographic/legal details unverified.
sources.implication: Matching majority-input inversion and column-sum correction are a disclosure lead, not a legal novelty ruling.

sources.authors: Lin, Rung-Bin and Tsai, Chi-Ming
sources.title: Weight-Based Bus-Invert Coding for Low-Power Applications
sources.access_note: Primary paper excerpts; DOI 10.1109/ASPDAC.2002.994897.
sources.implication: Weight means number of ones, not proof that our position-weighted electrical score is already published.

sources.authors: Bae, Soojung and Andrulis, Tanner and Sze, Vivienne and Emer, Joel S.
sources.title: Small-Noise is All You Need: Fast and Precise Estimation of Compute-in-Memory Accuracy Loss
sources.access_note: Author page explicitly says under submission and no public preprint.
sources.implication: Overlap warning; insufficient evidence to eliminate an independently specified estimator.

sources.authors: Deaville, Peter and Zhang, Bonan and Chen, Lung-Yen and Verma, Naveen
sources.title: A Maximally Row-Parallel MRAM In-Memory-Computing Macro Addressing Readout Circuit Sensitivity and Area
sources.access_note: Author PDF wiring/readout passages inspected; DOI 10.1109/ESSCIRC53450.2021.9567807.
sources.implication: Physical dimensions and logical input dimensions must be distinguished.

sources.title: A Fully Row/Column-Parallel MRAM in-Memory Computing Macro With Memory-Resistance Boosting and Weighted Multi-Column ADC Readout
sources.access_note: Publisher record; DOI 10.1109/JSSC.2024.3512360.
sources.implication: Large-array feasibility depends on actual cell/readout support, not nominal dimensions alone.

sources.authors: Qin, Yifan and others
sources.title: When Small Variations Become Big Failures: Reliability Challenges in Compute-in-Memory Neural Accelerators
sources.access_note: Short overview of earlier worst-case, selective write-verify and training results inspected.
sources.implication: Tail-risk discussion and selective mitigation alone are insufficient novelty.

sources.authors: Yang and others
sources.title: Sparse ReRAM Engine: Joint Exploration of Activation and Weight Sparsity in Compressed Neural Networks
sources.access_note: Primary thesis record and author retrospective; not a full system reproduction.
sources.implication: Earlier sparsity-aware architecture context, not the exact CAR algorithm.

sources.authors: Jiang and others
sources.title: Mixtral of Experts
sources.access_note: Primary paper record.
sources.implication: Expert selection is an application opportunity; selected expert computations remain relevant.

sources.authors: Song, Choongseok and Sim, Yonguk and Jeong, Doo Seok
sources.title: Input Sparsity-Aware Computing-In-Memory with Bidirectional Conversion-Skippable Analog-to-Digital Converter
sources.access_note: Primary PDF introductory/method excerpts; DOI 10.1002/aisy.202501336. Subsequent retrieval was intermittent.
sources.implication: Block and element conversion skipping is a required ADC-policy comparator.

sources.authors: Roy, Saion K. and Ou, Han-Mo and Ahmed, Mostafa G. and Deaville, Peter and Zhang, Bonan and Verma, Naveen and Hanumolu, Pavan K. and Shanbhag, Naresh R.
sources.title: Compute SNDR-Boosted 22-nm MRAM-Based In-Memory Computing Macro Using Statistical Error Compensation
sources.access_note: Primary institutional abstract; JSSC DOI 10.1109/JSSC.2024.3442013. Full compensation implementation must be obtained.
sources.implication: Offset compensation and correction of wire-induced nonlinearity are essential strong baselines.

sources.authors: Sharma, Pratham and Khan, Mohd Faisal and Vishvakarma, Santosh Kumar
sources.title: SLICE-CiM: Selective Layer-wise Inference Control Engine with Confidence-Based Early Exit for SRAM based Digital Compute-in-Memory
sources.access_note: Preprint sections II-III inspected; threshold, MSB-first tail bound and calibration. Bound normalization needs independent checking.
sources.implication: Confidence-based early termination is occupied; an analog-MRAM method requires a specific difference.

sources.authors: Crafton, Brian and Spetalnick, Samuel and Yoon, Jong-Hyeok and Raychowdhury, Arijit
sources.title: Statistical Optimization of Compute In-Memory Performance Under Device Variation
sources.access_note: Author PDF Sections II-III; Equations 1-3 and WL-count LUT optimization inspected. DOI 10.1109/ISLPED52811.2021.9502484. Not an end-to-end full-paper review.
sources.implication: Marginal ADC-code PMFs and bit-significance-aware parallelism already exist. Distinguish a cross-read second-moment mapping score; do not present their weighted MAE approximation as a covariance method or automatically invalid.

sources.authors: Hong, Seungki and Jeong, Kyeongwon and Jang, Taekwang
sources.title: Snowball: A Scalable All-to-All Ising Machine with Dual-Mode Markov Chain Monte Carlo Spin Selection and Asynchronous Spin Updates for Fast Combinatorial Optimization
sources.access_note: Section IV-B.2 initialization and incremental update equations inspected; digital FPGA implementation, not a reproduced MRAM architecture.
sources.implication: Initialized cached fields, incremental updates and dual row/column bit-plane layouts are prior-art baselines.

sources.authors: Volpe, Deborah and Raimondo, Eleonora and Grimaldi, Andrea and others
sources.title: A Scalable and Resource-Efficient Pipelined p-Computer for Probabilistic Ising Machines
sources.access_note: Publisher Sections 3.1-3.2 inspected; DOI 10.1002/aisy.70521. Full FPGA implementation and performance are not reproduced.
sources.implication: Initialized local fields with incremental flip-triggered updates are established; cached and full-recomputation operators need separate controls.
